key: byte-exact kNormalizedKey; shard = sha256(utf8(K)) first 2 hex chars
shard_path: shards/{shard}.bin, beside this index (the base's own pattern is data/route-store/shards/{shard}.bin)
route_row: 1 when the reading is a piece cut out of a sibling standing on the same record; null otherwise (v1 omitted the slot; v2 writes null so that HEADWORDS is always at [6])

HEADWORDS: array of the source's own headword strings for this (key, route_text, source label) — verbatim bytes of catalog source_headword; distinct by exact string, no cap, no normalisation, pointed and unpointed both kept. Rows non-empty in v2 carry v2's array unchanged (first appearance in (source_priority, source_order, catalog row) order via the unmerged lattice cards). Rows empty in v2 carry the DIRECT catalog join: catalog rows at (K == k_normalized_key.trim(), m_sources[m_id].label == m_source_label) whose r_route_text == route_text (WHOLE) or, for wikisource_strongs_explicit_forms only, whose r_route_text separated on the declared comma outside parentheses yields route_text as one piece byte-exact, the first piece admissible also with its one or two head hyphens removed and then trimmed (PIECE) — WHOLE and PIECE matches unioned; first appearance in catalog row order. [] when no catalog row joined (see counts). Label-level: several m_ids share one label and receive the label's array. v2.2 REPAIR (RULE-store-v2.2-v1.md §3-§5): on the rows whose v2.1 array held no string equal to any source_headword reached by the evidence road (store row -> sidecar cards at (rank, route_text, m_id) -> evidence_support_id -> catalog row in the row's own cell), the array is REPLACED by the distinct non-empty source_headword strings of those catalog rows, verbatim, catalog row order. Every other row is v2.1's.

route_row_in_this_overlay.0: semantic_route_rank = R(K) + n: R(K) the largest rank of the base store's rows at K (0 when the base has no K), n = 1.. in the sidecar's own order; every overlay row sorts after every base row at K on this slot, and on this slot only
route_row_in_this_overlay.1: route_text: the sidecar card's field 2, byte for byte
route_row_in_this_overlay.2: definition_text: the sidecar card's field 3, byte for byte
route_row_in_this_overlay.4: the wording year: 1903 by P-W1-JASTROW (the looked-at title page), or the earlier year of a byte-identical definition text carried at the same key by a base row whose own year is a ruled work's (W1 or W4), the collector rule
route_row_in_this_overlay.5: the cut flag, derived by the fold's own isFragment and fragmentPosture over the overlay's own rows grouped by (m_id, definition_text)
route_row_in_this_overlay.6: HEADWORDS: the pointing store v2.2's array for (K, route_text, source label), label-level; [] when no v2.2 row joins

selection: every card of the unmerged sidecar whose m_id's sidecar index entry has key sefaria_jastrow_1903, one overlay row each; nothing else

toggle.sort_rule: below every era-appropriate and tradition source at the same tier
toggle.off_means: no overlay row enters the pool; the base store answers alone, exactly as it does without this overlay
toggle.on_means: the overlay rows enter the pool marked RABBINIC with their year, and sort after every base reading at the same tier; they never lower a base reading's year or rank
toggle.the_rank_does_not_implement_the_sort_rul: the page sorts by tier, year, then rank, and merges readings by text taking the oldest year; a rank after the base does not keep a 1903 Jastrow reading below an undated or 1906 base reading. The serving lane's comparator must place the witness toggle first; see strand-1-overlay/out/page-order-v1.json

ruling.owner_sentence: well i've reflected and i think we can include jastrow and even ben yehuda new hebrew, but i need it to be heavily controlled under toggle

toggle.turning_it_on: the serving lane's wiring and the reader's switch; nothing here is live
toggle.base_admission_record: the base index's language_admission.struck_m_ids names M12, M39, M49, M52, M65, M75, M106, M108; this overlay does not edit that record. Whether the toggle, when on, passes these rows through the admission gate is the serving lane's wiring and the owner's ruling; the source's own language field is quoted on each m_sources entry
